alternatives.name: SQLITE_ONLY
tradeoffs: Simple offline packaging but weak analytical scan performance on multi-million-row fixtures.

alternatives.name: SQLITE_METADATA_DUCKDB_ANALYTICAL
tradeoffs: Matches admitted 8MB equity fixture today while leaving room for larger analytical tables later.
Requires separate offline dependency authorization before DuckDB is introduced in Phase 2.

negative: DuckDB dependency must be separately authorized before Phase 2 storage implementation.
positive: Logical layout can be implemented without committing to a single engine for all workloads.

decision.summary: Logical storage layout is fixed now; physical engines are SQLite for run metadata and manifests and DuckDB for analytical columnar datasets once Phase 2 begins. No production storage is implemented in Phase 1.
decision.title: Storage layout and physical engine

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance records the decision only. It does not authorize Phase 2 implementation, adapters, replay, models, providers, brokers, donor execution, or network access.
